summary: Build skills in baselines, additionality, monitoring, verification readiness, and buyer due diligence. Explore the five-day course outline.
lede: Carbon project development training helps project developers, climate programme managers, consultants and sustainable-finance teams prepare carbon-credit projects for technical review and buyer due diligence. Participants practise assessing baselines and additionality, designing monitoring plans, tracking risks such as leakage and permanence, and organizing evidence for verification and commercial review.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who develop, assess, monitor, finance, or purchase carbon-credit projects and need to make project evidence usable across technical and commercial reviews. This course is designed for: Carbon Project Developers preparing project design documents and methodology selections. Climate Programme Managers coordinating baseline studies, monitoring, and verification timelines. Environmental Consultants assessing project additionality, leakage, and permanence risks. Carbon Methodology Analysts reviewing quantification methods and project boundary assumptions. Carbon Monitoring Officers maintaining activity data and monitoring records. Validation and Verification Coordinators organizing evidence and responding to findings. NGO Carbon Programme Leads aligning benefit-sharing plans with community project delivery. Sustainable-Finance Analysts screening carbon-project integrity and commercial risks. Carbon Procurement Managers conducting buyer due diligence on project documentation. Agriculture and Forestry Programme Specialists developing land-based carbon project activities.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with climate or environmental projects is recommended. No coding or programming is required; exercises focus on project documents, evidence, and monitoring decisions. Participants should be comfortable reviewing project data and technical documentation.
